blocking_findings.problem: The proposed check() read has no explicit final-symlink guard. regular_bytes uses getattr(os, O_NOFOLLOW, 0), so on platforms without O_NOFOLLOW, notably Windows, a supported file symlink to the valid original manifest is opened as a regular target. --check can return configured and --doctor can proceed rather than controlled refusal. install/uninstall already call checked_target and reject the leaf. The candidate therefore does not meet its cross-entry symlink-refusal contract on a supported-symlink Windows host.
blocking_findings.requested_change: Within this setup-manifest scope, add an explicit existing-path guard for check() inside its caught-error boundary, reusing checked_target or equivalent existing guard, without modifying the frozen shared helper or weakening/skipping the new symlink assertions.
